note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All texts, provisions, levels and readings are fictional placeholders; jurisdiction unspecified. Link states are supplied by the author, never inferred; no instrument is shown to be valid, lawful or binding and the hierarchy is only displayed.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: A reader checks the basis clause of a fictional instrument with a lens; a clerk carries the link cord to the enabling page (Text 1 · Art. 12) and clips it there for the supplied state 'authorization supplied'.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: different fictional texts and wording, both texts on the same user-supplied level, and the supplied state 'authorization to be checked' — the clerk lays the clip open on the desk beside the enabling page instead of fastening it, the cord stays slack and the passage only gets a dashed pencil outline.
